instrument: Proposed two-year data center ban, Buffalo Common Council
summary: A proposed two-year ban on data centers showed enough council support at hearing to pass; the sponsor expects a possibly unanimous vote. Mayoral signature uncertain.

source.citation: Strisker Data Centers Weekly Briefing, Sept 21-24, 2026 (digest), citing local reporting (WGRZ)

notes: Buffalo News reports the moratorium would apply to data centers of 20 MW or more and include crypto-mining and blockchain facilities; resolution not read.  Corroborated: WKBW and Buffalo News both report the 20 MW threshold; six sponsors including Golombek (veto-proof); mayor's office says Corporation Counsel will review if passed. Resolution text not located.

next.event: Buffalo Common Council vote on two-year data center ban
